questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.
Mrs. Meera and family / received his letter / a week ago
questions.solution:
D) No error
The sentence has no error because the 'his' in 'received his letter' refers to another person who sent the letter. Therefore, there is no error in the sentence.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.
Ramya is working / hardly / to get good marks.
questions.solution:
B)'hardly'के बदले 'hard' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'hardly' का अर्थ है 'मुश्किल से' जो इस वाक्य के संदर्भ में सही नहीं है; सही शब्द 'hard' है जिसका अर्थ है 'कड़ी मेहनत से'; जैसे— Ramya is working hard to get good marks.
'hard' will be used instead of'hardly'because 'hardly' means 'barely' which is not correct in the context of this sentence; the correct word is 'hard' which means 'with a lot of effort'; Like— Ramya is working hard to get good marks.

questions.question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.
His mother’s transfer from a small town to Delhi brought up a huge change in his schooling.
options: from a small town to Delhi
questions.solution:
D) 'brought up' के बदले'brought about'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'brought up' का अर्थ 'पालना' होता है जबकि 'brought about' का अर्थ 'लाना' या ‘घटित करना' होता है; जैसे— The new policy brought about significant changes in the education system.
'brought about'will be used instead of 'brought up' because 'brought up' means 'to raise' while 'brought about' means 'to cause' or 'to result in'; Like— The new policy brought about significant changes in the education system.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
Urgent activities are those things / that you must do immediately, / as they require quick action / and cannot be put on.
questions.solution:
A) 'put on' के बदले 'put off' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि वाक्य में ‘put on’ का अर्थ 'वस्त्र धारण करना' होता है जबकि संदर्भ में ‘put off’ का अर्थ 'स्थगित करना' अधिक उपयुक्त है; जैसे— She had to put off her meeting due to an emergency.
'put off' will be used instead of 'put on' because in the sentence, ‘put on’ means 'to wear clothes,' while in the context, 'put off' meaning 'to postpone' is more appropriate; like— She had to put off her meeting due to an emergency.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
Rashmi was / quite amusing when / she heard about / what had happened
questions.solution:
C) 'amusing' के बदले 'amused' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि वाक्य Passive Voice में है और ‘amused’ का अर्थ 'प्रसन्न' या 'मनोरंजन हुआ' अधिक उपयुक्त है; जैसे— She was quite amused by the joke.
'amused' will be used instead of 'amusing' because the sentence is in Passive Voice and ‘amused’ meaning 'pleased' or 'entertained' is more appropriate; like— She was quite amused by the joke.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
(1) When Christy (2) grew out, (3) he turned out (4) to be a gentleman
questions.solution:
B) 'grew out' के बदले'grew up'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'grow out' का अर्थ है ‘to become too large to wear something’ जबकि 'grow up' का अर्थ है ‘to become an adult’; जैसे— He grew up to be a successful man.
'grew up'will be used instead of 'grew out' because 'grow out' means ‘to become too large to wear something’ while 'grow up' means ‘to become an adult’; Like— He grew up to be a successful man.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
The meeting / will taking / place next / Wednesday
questions.solution:
D)'will taking'के बदले 'will take' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि Modal Verb 'will' के बाद हमेशा Base Form (Simple Form) का प्रयोग होता है; जैसे— The meeting will take place next Wednesday.
'will take'will be used instead of 'will taking' because after the Modal Verb 'will', the Base Form (Simple Form) of the verb is always used; Like— The meeting will take place next Wednesday.

questions.question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.
Today she said to her friend, “You’re the sweetest person I have met ever”.
questions.solution:
D) have met' के बदले'met'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि direct speech के Reporting Verb 'said' Past Tense में है, अत: Reporting Verb Past Tense में होने के कारण indirect speech के verb को भी Past Tense में होना चाहिए; जैसे— She said, "I went to the market."
'met'will be used instead of 'have met' because the Reporting Verb 'said' in direct speech is in Past Tense. Therefore, since the Reporting Verb is in Past Tense, the verb in indirect speech should also be in Past Tense; Like— She said, "I went to the market."

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an INCORRECT preposition.
Please remember to take / your notice to the reception area / if you want it to be displayed / upon the bulletin board
options: your notice to the reception area
if you want it to be displayed
questions.solution:
B) Upon' के बदले'on'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि ‘on’ सही preposition है जब हम किसी सतह या जगह का उल्लेख करते हैं; जैसे— Please put the book on the table.
'on'will be used instead of 'upon' because 'on' is the correct preposition when we refer to a surface or a place; Like— Please put the book on the table.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
Don’t go / outside / because it is / raining heavy.
questions.solution:
A) 'raining heavy' के बदले 'rainingheavily'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'raining' verb के रूप में उपयोग हो रहा है और उसे modify करने के लिए adverb की आवश्यकता है; जैसे— It was raining heavily throughout the night.
raining 'heavily'will be used instead of 'heavy' because 'raining' is used as a verb and needs to be modified by an adverb; Like— It was raining heavily throughout the night.

questions.question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.
The class / teacher was / wounded in / a leg.
questions.solution:
D) 'A leg' के बदले 'the leg' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि हम किसी व्यक्ति के एक विशेष अंग के बारे में बात कर रहे हैं; जैसे— He was wounded in the leg.
• 'the leg' will be used instead of 'a leg' because we are talking about a specific part of a person's body; Like— He was wounded in the leg.

questions.question:
Identify the grammatical error in the following sentence and select the correct tense from the options given below.
I have met my friend yesterday
questions.solution:
D) ‘have met' के बदले'met'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि ‘yesterday’ बीते हुए समय का बोध कराता है अत: Simple Past Tense का प्रयोग होगा; जैसे— I met my friend yesterday.
'met'will be used instead of 'have met' because 'yesterday' indicates a past time, so Simple Past Tense will be used; Like— I met my friend yesterday.

questions.question:
Select the option that will improve the given sentence by using the most appropriate verb.
That Macbook belong to Xavier
options: That Macbook is belong to Xavier.
That Macbook is belonged to Xavier.
questions.solution:
A) That Macbook belongs to Xavier.
‘belong' के बदले 'belongs' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि subject 'Macbook' singular है अतः verb में भी singular form 'belongs' का प्रयोग होगा; जैसे— That Macbook belongs to Xavier.
'belongs' will be used instead of 'belong' because the subject 'Macbook' is singular, so the verb should also be in the singular form 'belongs'; Like— That Macbook belongs to Xavier.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
The teacher was / taken back by / the audacity of / the new student. A B C D
questions.solution:
D) taken back' के बदले'taken aback'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि phrase 'taken aback' का अर्थ होता है 'to be surprised or shocked', जो यहाँ उचित है; जैसे— The teacher was taken aback by the audacity of the new student.
'taken aback'will be used instead of 'taken back' because the phrase 'taken aback' means 'to be surprised or shocked', which is appropriate here; Like— The teacher was taken aback by the audacity of the new student.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.
I had seen / her with her mother / in the cinema hall / yesterday.
questions.solution:
C) had seen' के बदले'saw'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि वाक्य में 'yesterday' है, जो कि Simple Past Tense का संकेतक है। इसलिए 'had seen' की जगह 'saw' का प्रयोग किया जाएगा; जैसे— I saw her with her mother in the cinema hall yesterday.
'saw'will be used instead of 'had seen' because the sentence contains 'yesterday', which indicates Simple Past Tense. Therefore, 'saw' will be used instead of 'had seen'; Like— I saw her with her mother in the cinema hall yesterday.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into three segments. One of them may contain an adverbial usage error. Select the option that has the segment with the error. If you don’t find any error, select ‘No error’ as your answer.
Mr. Narayanan / is a rather / lazy man.
questions.solution: D) No error.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a spelling error.
In all instances of frustrasion, / you will always find / the anger directed towards / a single person only.
questions.solution: C) The correct spelling of ‘frustrasion’ is ‘frustration’which means “the feeling of being upset or annoyed as a result of being unable to change or achieve something” हताशा.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
My students are / waiting for / their flights / at the gate no. 6
questions.solution:
C) 'at the gate no. 6' में त्रुटि है। सही वाक्य होना चाहिए 'at gate no. 6' क्योंकि Proper Nouns जैसे 'Gate No. 6' से पहले 'the' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है। सही वाक्य होगा: My students are waiting for their flights at gate no. 6.
Exceptions: In each of these cases, the article is omitted because the name itself is specific enough and does not require an article for clarification. However, there are exceptions to this rule, especially when the name includes words like "Republic," "Kingdom," or when referring to a group of islands, rivers, or mountain ranges:

questions.question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.
I am sure / that he will praying / for a good crop / this year.
questions.solution:
C) 'that he will praying'मेंerrorहै।सहीवाक्यहोगा'that he will be praying'क्योंकि'will'केबादFuture Continuous Tenseमें'be'काप्रयोगहोताहैऔरउसकेबादVerbकी'-ing' formआतीहै।सहीवाक्यहोगा: I am sure that he will be praying for a good crop this year.
The error is in 'that he will praying'. The correct phrase should be 'that he will be praying' because in the Future Continuous Tense, 'will' is followed by 'be' and then the '-ing' form of the verb. The correct sentence should be: I am sure that he will be praying for a good crop this year.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
I am very much / obliged of my friend / for the help / he rendered to me.
questions.solution:
B) ‘of' के बदले 'to' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'obliged' के साथ 'to' का प्रयोग किया जाता है; जैसे— I am obliged to you for your help.
'to' will be used instead of 'of' because 'obliged' is used with 'to'; Like— I am obliged to you for your help.
